---
title: "About"
---

My name is Vikrant. I like databases and system software. This blog is an attempt to explain to myself how databases work.

Right now, this mostly means topics around Postgres and ClickHouse. I'm trying to explore more OLAP databases going forward.
Typically, I put a video on my [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@TheWALStreetJournal), for each blog post.

## Get new posts by email

One email when a new post or video is out. Nothing else.
